## Behavior

What did you expect, and what happened instead?

## Reproduction

Include steps, SolveCraft version/commit and relevant environment details. Prefer a small example without private design data.

## Concrete visual context (when helpful)

If a screenshot, short demo, diagram or example model view helps make the problem concrete, include it with the reproduction steps, even for kernel, geometry, assembly or backend behavior. Coding agents should run the example and capture the actual result themselves when possible, rather than asking a human for evidence they can produce. Annotate the focus when helpful. Exclude private designs and sensitive details; attach media or use an accessible link, not committed generated artifacts. Problems with no useful visual explanation do not require media.
